title: Grays rescued orphaned Chinese children and want to return them to humans
summary: Charles Hall tells of Grays rescued orphaned Chinese children and want to return them to humans, about 1960s at Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They were young Chinese people that the grace had rescued, not abducted, but they they had been orphaned and the grace had refued.

plain: Charles Hall says that in the 1960s, while he was stationed in Indian Springs Valley in Nevada, he spent time among beings he calls the tall whites. He told the podcast host Jesse Michels that he saw young Chinese people there who had been rescued by the grays, the small grey-skinned beings, after being orphaned. He insists they weren't abducted, and he says the grays want to return them to human society.
